items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Local inferencing
items.description:
Local inferencing expands Microsoft Copilot’s sovereign controls by enabling AI inferencing for supported Copilot interactions to occur within the applicable local geography.
Launching in Australia, India, the United Arab Emirates, the United Kingdom, and the United States, this capability gives organizations greater control over where AI inferencing occurs, helping them address sovereignty and regional requirements. Inferencing is the processing step when an AI model executes a prompt to produc

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
items.description: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings gives organizations greater control over access to sensitive meetings. Administrators can apply Conditional Access policies to selected meetings, helping ensure participants meet organizational security requirements before joining.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports knowledge source in criteria
items.description: Criteria questions can now use knowledge sources to help evaluate customer interactions. This allows organizations to ground evaluation criteria in approved knowledge content, policies, or guidance so quality checks can better reflect expected handling standards. This preview capability is scoped to case and on-demand evaluations.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Inactivate quality evaluation records
items.description: Quality managers can now inactivate evaluation records that should no longer contribute to scoring or reporting. Inactive evaluations are preserved for traceability but excluded from overall score calculations and analytics. This helps teams correct reporting outcomes when evaluations were created in error, used the wrong criteria, were duplicates, or should otherwise be removed from active quality results.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Support Not Applicable answer option for quality evaluation criteria
items.description: Criteria questions now support a Not Applicable answer option. When a question is marked as not applicable, it is excluded from scoring instead of negatively affecting the evaluation score. This helps ensure evaluations remain accurate when a specific criterion does not apply to the case, interaction, or business scenario being reviewed.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Detailed quality evaluation score breakdown
items.description: Evaluation details now include a scoring breakdown at the overall, section, and question level. Users can see how the final evaluation score was calculated, including how individual question outcomes contribute to section scores and the overall score. This improves transparency, helps quality teams validate results, and makes it easier to identify areas for coaching, calibration, and process improvement.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Ability for leaders to publish Power BI reports
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is extending its report publishing capabilities from analysts to leader personas such as Chief Officers, Managers and their delegates. This enhancement enables leaders to directly distribute curated reports within their organizations through a lightweight publishing experience, complementing the existing report customization features.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
items.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter or any participant’s video into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Identify custom apps that need updates for Teams private and shared channels
items.description: Admins will be able to view in Teams Admin Center a list of custom apps in their tenant that need to be updated to work in private and shared channels. This experience will help admins identify impacted apps, understand which apps require developer action, and coordinate updates so users can continue using custom apps across all supported channel types.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
items.description: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
items.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
items.description: Self-service diagnostics help identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The experience highlights potential misconfigurations and provides simple guidance to help customers understand and resolve them. This brings basic troubleshooting into the product and helps eDiscovery admins overcome common challenges.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay‑As‑You‑Go usage
items.description: Enables metered, pay‑as‑you‑go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre‑assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
items.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Fresh Copilot Metrics in Custom Person Queries & Reports- Viva Advanced Analysis
items.description: Key Microsoft 365 Copilot metrics in custom person queries and reports will have values up to 2-3 days old from the current date. This will provide fresher copilot usage analysis to analysts in Viva Advanced analysis.

items.title: SharePoint: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
items.description: Recipient groups in eSignature allow a recipient slot to be assigned to multiple people, such that any one  of those people can fulfil the signing requirement on behalf of the group.

items.title: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
items.description: This feature empowers authors to create rich, interactive charts with AI in SharePoint when editing SharePoint pages. Authors can describe the chart they want to create in plain language within a chat on a SharePoint page.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
items.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention– Unmanaged cloud app discovery and protection with Microsoft Purview and the Island Enterprise Browser
items.description: Microsoft Purview network data security now integrates with Island, extending protection to Island’s browser-based workflows at the point of user interaction. items.title: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
items.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Authoritative content management for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
items.description: Specify and manage SharePoint sites deemed as authoritative content to enhance their relevance and ranking in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, under Copilot > Search > Authoritative content, add and manage up to 100 SharePoint sites. #copilotcontrolsystem
